versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-cloudfw-vpc-firewall-diagnosis (version 0.0.1):

- Provides read-only diagnosis for Alibaba Cloud Cloud Firewall VPC firewall provisioning, route policy, and closure pre-check issues.
- Requires aliyun-cli >= 3.3.0, Python 3.6+, and only read-only RAM permissions.
- Ensures all Alibaba Cloud API calls use a specific User-Agent and enforce AI-Mode setup/teardown procedures.
- Strictly forbids any write, modify, or destructive operations; provides only analysis and configuration guidance.
- Includes Bash command whitelist and mandatory user input collection to ensure safe, controlled diagnostic actions.
